newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares lose ground in late electronic trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares lose ground in late electronic trade.

text.p: 1626 GMT - German shares lose ground in late trade, tracking Bunds and Wall Street. Volumes thinned out in late trade ahead of the Easter break, which will keep markets closed through to Tuesday.
* IBIS DAX index ends down 31.39 points at 3,407.83.
* June DTB DAX futures contract down 31 at 3,424 points.
* Daimler ends sharply lower after strong gains Wednesday on the back of 1996 earnings data.
* Bayerische Vereinsbank AG among best performers as bank merger talks continues.
